quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: Recognition
quest.description: The case draws to a close. The truth is at hand...

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here, as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ryuuji is currently investigating Yashiori Island to follow up on my hunches.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Let me mark the locations on your map. If you hurry, there will still be time to catch up with him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are we in such hurry? Wasn't Ryuuji gonna meet us here and head out together with us?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Because this investigation is fast approaching its end, of course. Hurry now. We're about to witness the truth coming to light.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ooh, now that you say it like that, Paimon's getting all excited too! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go!

talks.objective: Find Ryuuji and talk to him

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ryuuji! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. Sango sent me here to do some preliminary investigations, saying that you would arrive shortly. Indeed you have.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, she told us you'd be here! How's everything going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. There's nothing here but a bunch of cages for small animals. Where are the people at?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: They just left. It's the Treasure Hoarders. Sango told me that they were planning to steal dogs and train them to become Treasure Hunting Hounds.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Exactly. The thing about weasels is that they're mischievous creatures that are hard to teach. As such, their training was a failure. This time, they were planning to try this again, but with the more loyal "dogs."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Previously, we also handled quite a few commissions regarding the Treasure Hoarders. Now that I think about it, Sango was right about that, too.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Just as people leave footprints behind, so too, do organizations leave unique traces. Although there were other lost and imprisoned animals that came up throughout this process, the signs eventually pointed back to the Treasure Hoarders all the same.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: After consulting the previous methods we used to resolve these cases, I found my investigations leading me here.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Still, to not leave a single guard behind... I must say that these perpetrators are just way too careless.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's real complacent of them, alright! Still, Paimon's sure that even you're tired after so many days of fighting, aren't you, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's what Paimon was just thinking!

choices.text: Guess we can just snag the animals in secret.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. This dog isn't leaving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it ill?
Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It's...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? No, c'mon, what sort of nickname is that?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Well, whatever the case. He seems to have no desire to attack us...
Woof woof—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaand he's gone.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: He's turning back to look at us every so often. Does he want us to follow?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's catch up.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Indeed. Perhaps the truth really is ahead... Perhaps things are just as Sango predicted...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: No, no. It should be "Hat Dog."

talks.objective: Pursue the dog that ran off

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, we finally caught up.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Eh? There's some kind of... letter over here.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Let's read it. It is the last clue we have, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe, right! Let Paimon see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "To whomsoever..." Something something... Ugh, it's all battered and stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: It's probably "to whomsoever should read this letter."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Guess so. It goes on... "Our clan's profession is the training of ninken, and to this end we have provided the ninja with a great many reliable companions."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "...I fear that I am unlikely to return from this latest expedition of mine. I have no regrets, but if I were to still have worries, it would be for Kageroumaru."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "He was too weak when he was young, and so he was left out when the ninja came to make contracts with their ninken. That mattered little to me. As a trainer, I refused to give up on a single dog."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Day after day of training passed, and with each day, Kageroumaru grew stronger. Unfortunately, he has no wish to make a contract with any ninja."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "War has not broken out yet, but the Police Station's missives have become more urgent. I no longer have time to spend with him — it is time to go."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I can only leave this letter behind. If anyone should find it in the days to come, please help me take care of Kageroumaru."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "He has a scar on his face that we got when he was young, and he holds himself in manner evidently different from other dogs."

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: So the "Kageroumaru" the letter speaks of is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This fellow who brought us here, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He really is very unique! Hang on, there's more stuff here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I understand that this is a presumptuous request, but I do not have any other choice. Also, should he wish to make a contract in the future and can bring the one he wishes to follow to this place, then the method to make a contract is as follows..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, seriously!? The writer canceled the most important bit out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Probably thought this was impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: That is true. There was no evidence that would indicate otherwise from the beginning, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kageroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof woof—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eh? It ran off again, and into a building this time, too. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, after it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, that's that done. Still, that was strange. Kageroumaru seemed so friendly at first, and then before we knew it, we were in a fight! Thank goodness for {NICKNAME}, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...Actually, why's Kageroumaru following you around, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Kageroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof, woof!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This barking sounds... happier, somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How can you tell? Paimon didn't get it at all!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: #Unless I miss my guess, Kageroumaru is now {NICKNAME}'s ninken.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Well, I'm no expert on ninken contracts. However, they do say that a ninja must defeat a ninken to receive its acknowledgment.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ninja desire strong companions, and so too do ninken. Only through mutual recognition can such contracts be established. It certainly seems to be the case here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But {NICKNAME} isn't a ninja! And also... Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...Promise Paimon something, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've gotta promise first!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, sure, I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if you're now contracted to Kageroumaru, never forget that Paimon's your bestest companion ever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I promise never to forget that Paimon is my bestest companion ever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay!

choices.text: I mean, I'd call you more reliable...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh! We're the best of friends!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Ahem. It's nice to see that the two of you get along and all...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: But back to the topic at hand... If Kageroumaru really is so strong, then why did the person from before leave a letter asking someone to take care of him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh, ooh, Paimon knows this one! You see, Ryuuji, {NICKNAME} is super strong, right?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Far beyond the norm for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Right? But see, if someday, Paimon had to leave {NICKNAME}, Paimon would still be really worried. It's got nothing to do with whether {NICKNAME} is strong or not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Pfft, but that'll never happen! Paimon's just making an analogy and stuff, y'know? We won't split up, no way!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Your reasoning makes a lot of sense, Paimon. In which case, we're left with one final question. Why did this dog steal small animals from the villagers and then protect them?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, uh... Actually, that one's a toughie, even for Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It's a real shame that Kageroumaru can't speak, either. Otherwise, we could just get {NICKNAME} to ask him!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I suggest we look for Sango instead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that's right! Time for the brains of this operation to show her stuff, eh?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Agreed. Allow me to return these animals first, and we shall meet up at the agency later.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: We're back, Sango. Here's what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's the case. I think I've got a pretty good idea why Kageroumaru was protecting the little animals.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: He must have been trying to make the other animals stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: He must have been weak when he was little, only to become strong over time. It thus stands to reason that he wanted to help make the other animals stronger through training.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: But eventually, Kageroumaru found you, someone willing to protect the weak, and has thus acknowledged you as his master.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: This is also born from his sympathy for the weak.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, that's what my deductions from the clues we currently have would say, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: As for the actual circumstances, I doubt I'm particularly far off, but since Kageroumaru can't speak, we won't get a firm answer either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That really makes sense. As expected of the "brains" of this operation, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Kageroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof woof woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehe, you're agreeing with Sango, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Haha. Thanks for the flattery, but that's not going to net you any discounts if you ever send me a commission. Still, I guess we can consider this case closed.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Many thanks to the two of you, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I almost forgot. How did you find using the Ubiquity Net?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Alright, noted. I'll send your feedback to my friend. Thanks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No problem! Feel free to come to us if you ever have any problems. {NICKNAME} will be on the case in no time!

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: You're indeed very skilled, Traveler. But there's no need for these pleasantries. Sentimentality is the enemy of truth, after all.

choices.text: Trust me, I lived in fear of it tearing...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Looks like this matter is coming to a close...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: What should we call this case... "The Phantom Dog Owner"? "The Treasure Hoarder with Twelve Faces"?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ugh. Naming this case is going to be hard. Should just ask someone from Yae Publishing House next time, I think.
